Renewed Factory Unlocked S10e Review. The Renewed Factory Unlocked Samsung Galaxy S10e looks like the best bang for the buck right now (6/2020), since everyone is eyeing the more expensive S20 models. Try to get a Factory Unlocked version, not just a Carrier Unlocked version. So what does "fully unlocked" in the product description really mean? I got a Carrier-unlocked T-Mobile phone (for the S10e, model numbers end with TMB) from vendor Synergy, not a Samsung factory unlocked phone (for the S10e, model numbers end with XAA), if that matters to you. Got to wonder how long T-Mobile will support this phone with software updates compared to Samsung. And be aware of the terms used on these Amazon pages, like Renewed, Used-Good, Used-VeryGood, etc. If something is less expensive, it might be in poorer condition.

💙 Beautiful camera. I've used Samsung Galaxy S10e for about 5 months and I'm very happy with it. I upgraded from Galaxy 7 edge to S10E and noticed a big difference. I wanted to get an iphone X, but after trying it out, I noticed that S10E has a better camera and beautiful filters.
Samsung Galaxy S10E 128GB. I love everything about it

Samsung Galaxy S10e, 128GB. As advertised. Works fine.

s10e Galaxy phone. Like the Samsung S10e for the size and features of finge3r recognition. Best price was on Amazon Prime and I got it in 2 days when I needed to replace my broken phone.

Item NOT what was in description. The described item was a Samsung Galaxy s10e unlocked. The item that I received was a Samsung Galaxy s10. Not to mention I went to add it to my account and it was still under another person's name so I was unable to use it and had to return.

-Very good value for the money. The Galaxy S10e is the best compromise for my uses between all 3 S10 (S10, S10+ and S10e).

Great phone!. I have a Samsung Galaxy S10e myself and needed to get my mother a new phone (she still had a flip phone). I found the S10e on Amazon that is renewed and factory unlocked. It was in excellent condition and works perfectly. We took it to our AT&T store and got a new SIM card and we were up and running. This phone is easier for her to use because I put all the items she will use on the home screen so she doesn't have to hunt through menus like she did on her flip phone. I have had Samsung Galaxy phones for years now and love them!
samsung galaxy s10e appears to be a lightly used renewed phone. great deal. not used yet.. phone looks new and appears to be a great deal. haven't activated it yet.

Great product and service. My Samsung galaxy s10e came in the condition as advertised and shipping came in earlier than expected. The phone was advertised as in very good condition and meets that criteria. And, most important of all, the phone was factory reset and I was able to work with my network provider to activate my phone easily.
Great renewed Samsung Galaxy S10e. I am very pleased. It works very well. The price wasn't bad at all and much more affordable than a brand new phone.
Galaxy S10e. Great phone
Like a new condition. I bought samsung galaxy s10e 256GB from Chubbiestech. It is like a new condition and good battery life.
No regrets. The Samsung Galaxy s10e was recommended by a friend. I am happy with my choice. I like the size of this phone and it does everything I would expect from my phone. Happy buyer

Great Phone! Verizon s10e. I got what i paid for on sale cheaper than second hand, a Samsung galaxy S10e, I upgraded from a note 9 on a budget and have been using this p I one for the past two weeks. LET ME JUST SAY it has been holding up like a dream and is handling much better than my note 9 even though it's barely an upgrade! I even dropped it on accident on tile first day and not a scratch. I quickly put on ascreen protector after. Still... Great phone!

SUPERB PHONE!. I damaged my Verizon Samsung Galaxy S8 phone and refused to pay the insurance deductible for a replacement, and opted to purchase a Samsung Galaxy S10e from Amazon instead based on the positive reviews. I wanted a phone that had the same basic functionalities that I loved about my S8 (e.g headphones port) but gave me more GB without spending 1K. This phone exceeded expectations and was well worth the wait (my delivery took almost 2 weeks). I ordered my phone from thegadgetdeals and indicated my carrier was Verizon when I ordered. My phone was completely compatible and the activation was flawless. Additionally, my cardinal red phone looked brand new (no scratches). If I experience any issues I will definitely update this review but so far, so good! If you are on the fence about ordering, just do it and I recommend indicating your carrier upon ordering.

Had an Issue with Notification alert sound.. Upgrading from a Galaxy s7 for better performance and features but, didn't want to pay full price for the latest upgrade. Decided on the S10e. The size is almost identical to my s7 and I wanted to stay w this size. I was told by a Samsung tech that all of the newer phones since the s7 are bigger, w the exception of the s10e. Shipping was fast. It was delivered by Fedex carrier. Great packaging. Only rec'd the phone, wall charger and cable, w sim removal device. No manual, but I found all that online and a few YouTube videos, no problem. As stated by other reviews, the phone was in "Like New" condition. I removed my sim card from the s7 and installed it into the s10e and the phone came alive, NP.

False Advertising.. My complaint is not the product, but the advertising. Samsung Galaxy S10e Factory Unlocked Phone with 128GB (You.S. Warranty) ; ASIN - B07N4PM7NK. Product clearly states there is a WARRANTY in the title and description (image of product shows a graphic: "Samsung You.S. Limited Warranty*". This is FALSE ADVERTISING. Customer Service says there is NO WARRANTY.

I have plenty of chargers so I don't really care.

Perfect, looks brand new. This is the 2nd Amazon certified renewed Samsung Galaxy phone I've purchased in the last couple weeks- a Galaxy Note 10+ and this, the Galaxy S10e. Both were perfect with no discernible difference between them and a new in box phone.
Working great!. We purchased this refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10e because his old one died. Thus far this refurbished phone is working great without any issues
Samsung Galaxy S10e (renewed). This phone works as well as a new one. Actually looks new. I saved hundreds of dollars compared to a new one.
Satisfied. I just got my Samsung Galaxy S10e and I'm so satisfied! So far, so good! I hope it works as well as it looks! Looks brand new! Thank you so much!

Love my new Galaxy S10e. Very happy with my new Galaxy S10e. It worked well out of the box. T-Mobile easily transferred my info from my S6. It operates exactly as expected, and is easy to use. The battery life is great.15 hours off the charger and I’m at 61%.
Galaxy S10e. Refurbished phone in excellent condition.
Sleek S10e. This samsung s10e is More then my expectation. I thought I should have bought just the s10 but now I am loving the sleek style of s10e.

Galaxy S10 e and S6 edge share. One thing I did discover, is this. If you have a Otterbox Defender, for a Samsung Galaxy S6 edge, the outer belt clip will work on the S10e Otterbox Defender too, to that's a bonus.

Samsung Galaxy S10e, 128GB - Fully Unlocked (Renewed) - Everything is Perfect!. My phone came from Tech Exchangee. The phone arrived FEDEX a couple of days before promised. This is a true factory unlocked phone. I use Straight Talk as my carrier. I put in my Straight Talk GSM micro SIM card from my old Galaxy S8, and the phone setup was seemless - no problems at all. The phone does have the Qualcom Snapdragon 855 processor. The battery life is excellent on this phone. The phone came with an aftermarket wall charger and a short charging cord. The "pin" to release the SIM card was not there, but the end of a small to medium wire paperclip works just fine. I used the Samsung Smart Switch app to transfer my pictures, documents, contacts, and apps, from my old S8 to this S10E, and that worked perfectly.

Phone Outer Condition Great but not Unlocked. I ordered a Samsung Galaxy S10E and received the phone very quickly [great shipping time]. The phone in appearance wise is excellent; looks brand new. The only negative is that description notes phone fully unlocked but that is false. Followed instructions that came within box for activation and per my phone carrier the phone was locked/tied to another. So had to return and ship phone back to seller. Thus why giving the 3 star review...
Samsung Galaxy S10e, 128GB, Prism Black - For Verizon (Renewed). Arrived earlier than projected, in very nice condition, with very good battery life. Better than advertised!

Actually unlocked - works well with obscure carriers!. After 6 months of spinning my wheels with pseudo-unlocked Galaxy s10e's from sellers like CellTrader (protip-they misrepresent their phones!), it is so nice to finally get a phone that isn't full of carrier bloat ware, and also automatically downloads APN settings from my carrier!

Love the size and features of this phone!. I love this phone! I upgraded from a Galaxy S7 to the Galaxy S10e and it is a big improvement. The S10e is faster and was easy to set up. I like the way it fits in my hand and new camera features.
Samsung S10e. Great phone

Set Up Smooth & Easy. Unlocked refurbished S10e arrived over the weekend. Looks brand new. After charging, swapped out SIM with old Galaxy J7. Downloaded Samsung Smart Switch to J7. Powered up S10e, and it connected right away to T-Mobile; phone worked immediately. Transferring ALL data and apps worked flawlessly; took about 30 minutes total. So far 5 stars. Will update regarding battery life, since this has been mentioned in several other reviews.

Came with a defect - S10e from Samsung fulfilled by Amazon. I ordered the Samsung Galaxy S10e Factory Unlocked Phone with 128GB (You.S. Warranty), Prism Blue which was priced $100 less than retail at $639 then $649 in cart (?). I ordered two. One for myself and the other (Samsung Galaxy S10e Factory Unlocked Phone with 128GB (You.S. This phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network. I was so happy with the phone. It arrived quicker than promised. It was in excellent condition. It was packaged professionally. THEN... After 4 lengthy calls with AT&T, I called the Seller, GizmoTrader. The Customer Service Rep was extremely nice but he confirmed this phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network in February after they delete the 3G service. The Samsung S10e Model # G970F is not included on AT&T's list of phones that will work. There are other S10e Model #'s that will work but this one will not.

Looks brand new and operates flawlessly. This "Amazon Renewed" Samsung Galaxy S10e arrived ahead of schedule, and is in perfect condition! The only small quirk is that my purchase order was for a Prism Black phone, and what I received was the Prism White! However, the color error is totally OK because the phone is already in a full case. My wife has had an S10e for 2+ yrs (was $850 when first introduced in 2019), so I know what to expect, and my "renewed" phone is operating flawlessly. Also, this phone is factory unlocked, not just carrier unlocked, so it can be used worldwide - just pop in a SIM for that area. I highly recommend this phone to my fellow Amazon buyers.
Galaxy s10e. Phone looked brand new with minimal signs of wear.

Big leap forward for me. I moved from Galaxy S7 edge to a Galaxy 10e, so I'm not sure how valuable my review would be to someone. The S10e is great. Here's a brief punch list of my impressions: Thumbprint reader on the upper right side: Some people say it is not convenient, but I think it is immeasurably better than the front lower reader on the S7 edge. On the S7 edge I have to shift my pinky to hook the bottom edge of the phone so I can re-position my hand and place thumb on the reader, then I have to move back to my normal holding position. On the S10e, my thumb is already in position- no shifting necessary. The S10e reader is much faster and accurate. Face recognition: My S7 edge did not have this feature. I had no idea how convenient face recognition could be! What a time saver!
Samsung s10e. Just like new.

Galaxy phones can't be beat & the S10e is no exception.. This phone replaces a Galaxy J3 which was a great phone, just wanted to upgrade. I don't think you could tell the difference between my S10e and a brand new phone. What I really like about the Galaxy's is the user friendliness. I am a senior & have no problem using this phone. Battery life seems to be good, & camera is superb. Overall I totally recommend this phone. Also the price was great.Gal

This is not a scam!. Like many other consumers, I was very very worried that my phone would be a stolen phone or that it would not come carrier unlocked. The seller was Chubbiestech and my phone came factory unlocked to my relief. I do think it's important to check who the seller is specifically. All that aside, the phone works great! I love the smaller size of the Galaxy s10e compared the the s10 or s10+. All the cameras take fantastic pictures. As always, Samsung killed it.

Like new, works flawlessly. My Samsung Galaxy S10E unlocked(renewed) arrived in perfect condition. It was shipped with a generic charger. Any instructions needed I found online with YouTube. It took my T-Mobile SIM flawlessly. I used the Samsung smart switch app to transfer my data and apps from my old Samsung (S6Edge) to the S10E. The finger print reader works well enough, but often requires a couple attempts. Battery life is a huge improvement over the S6, phone can last a whole day with average utilization. The price was fabulous. I am very satisfied with purchase.

No issues with Phone looks good like no scratches. I bought this unlocked Samsung Galaxy S10E G970U phone for a family member and everything works just as good as the new phone I bought myself. It has service and the camera works just as well. The only thing I notice is this one did not come with a screen protector on it in the amazon packaging. The new phones all come with a film screen cover from Samsung to keep from feeling sharp edges from the glass screen covers. The only thing I noticed it the firmware versions are not the same between the two phones. I am not sure if that is a simcard or internal chip difference issue. They both are on the same carrier, Verizon. It is a GSM phone but it is compatible with Verizon phone network.

Excellent phone from Cellular Edge. I've had this phone a few weeks now (Samsung Galaxy s10e) and I believe that it is excellent (like new) condition. The folks at Cellular Edge are the ones to buy yours from and the only ones I'll trust for my next refurbished cell phone! I also purchased a Samsung Galaxy s10 from them for my son and had the same outstanding support experience and received another superior quality phone.

Overall a nice purchase.. Good enough, it's Carrier unlocked instead of factory unlocked but it doesn't makes any difference. The overall looks are great. And Samsung s10e is one of the best phones in my opinion because of the handy size and good capabilities.

Amazon’s error in this Samsung S10E phone transaction. I bought a Samsung S10E handphone for my godson. When he put in his SIM card, it did not work. Some sort of error message: Invalid SIM card. Network locked. SIM card inserted. Seller listed as Lifeline 786, fulfilled by Amazon. I wrote to Amazon about this problem, and awaiting their remedial action, lest I ask for a full refund if the phone cannot work in Singapore. -Mr Stephen Lee.

I can't help thinking that issues like this are deliberate corporate curveballs, designed to encourage customers to buy new phones direct from the carrier. JMHO To sum up my review of this phone, I received an S10e in top notch condition and would highly recommend this renewed product.

Good phone bad charging cable. For those of you questioning the legitimacy of this refurbished phone, I was also weary. However after receiving the refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10e and using it now for over a month, I can confidently say it is reliable and authentic and legitimate. I have not had any issues with the phone, although I will say I was dissapointed with the fact that this phone did not even come with a Samsung certified charging cable or other Samsung accessories. The biggest issue with this is that the charging cable they sent me doesn't even charge the phone, it keeps coming up with an error message that it cannot charge with this cable. That is frustrating because you'd think they would have the decency to send you a charging cable that actually charges the phone, because now I have to get another charging cable.

Inoperative camera. The shipping was prompt and the phone was in excellent condition and appeared new, +1. This Samsung Galaxy S10e was delivered with an inoperative camera. Went through standard troubleshooting with safe mode & factory reset(s) to no avail. Returned.
Compatibility and price.. The Galaxy S10E is compatible with most any other device. The price was extremely inexpensive for the value.

So far, so good.. I had a Samsung Galaxy S9 and upgraded to S10e (refurbished by Amazon). I was impressed because the mobile phone looked brand new. It's more compact and a lot faster than the S9. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because the phone gets warm after I'm on a long (20-30 minute) call. I'm hoping in time this doesn't become an issue. Will update my review if this is the case. Otherwise, a great phone and great buy.

best ever in its class - s10e is an amazing smartphone - 8GB RAM and 256 GB ROM. had some issues with the phone not being able to update itself - probably due to the software that was installed on it - but after i changed it, to a samsung official software specific for my carrier, everything is normal i love the size, RAM and ROM capacity and the look of, what i consider to be, THE BEST SMARTPHONE DESIGN AND CONSTRUCT SO FAR! s10e price was excellent as well

Nice phone.. I have the Dual-Sim version S10e. It replaced my Galaxy Note 8. The screen resolution is noticeably worse than the Note 8 and other s10 models. I love the flat screen and the smaller form factor more than anything. The curved edges of the past Samsung phones has been a nuisance to daily use. The Dual Sim DOES WORK with VERIZON, SPRINT & others. You get 4G LTE speeds on all networks except AT&T. AT&T only gives you 4G speeds. I currently use Verizon as my main service and also have a T-Mobile SIM as my work line, all with one phone.

Love my new(ish) Galaxy S10e. I am not really a 'gadget guy' so I won't really go into much detail about the phone itself, but I will say that it was a worthwhile step up from my 4-year-old Galaxy S6. It is much faster, has better battery life, and the fingerprint sensor and facial recognition make it easier to use. The facial recognition seems very solid - the fingerprint sensor does too but occasionally takes 2 or 3 tries. Really just wanted to write a review with regard to it being an Amazon Renewed phone. There seems to be mixed reviews here which I am guessing is based on differences between the actual seller. Mine was from RE-CELL, and the experience was positive. The phone looks brand new. I have only had it for about a week but have not had any issues so far.

Excellent Buy. The s10e I received was in brand new condition and works great. I was able to remove the sim card from my iphone 6 and put it my s10e. Verizon network recognized almost immediate. Great purchase and experience.

Great phone!. I was very leary of buying a refurbished phone, but with Amazon guaranteeing it I took a chance and I am very glad I did. I rarely write reviews on here. But I wanted to pass along to anyone considering buying refurbished. My Samsung S10e works great and is everything I expected.

First impressions good. Review Update 11/21/22 I'm really quite pleased with this phone. It does everything my older S9+ did. The step-down in size and weight were just what I was looking for. It feels much more comfortable in my shirt pocket. Review Update 11/15/22 One of the things I've been noticing lately is my 4 year old Galaxy S9+ battery charge duration is deteriorating. Today I've spent 3 hours setting up the new S10e. So, with both phones starting at 100%, I've had the phones powered up side-by-side. At this moment the S9+ shows 55% charge and the S10e shows 70% This is much better than I expected. Initial Review 11/14/2022 I've had a Galaxy S9+ for 4 years. Three things have always bothered me. I decided to buy this inexpensive used phone to improve my daily interaction with phones. It turns out better than expected.

Samsung Galaxy S10e - Flamingo Pink - Unlocked GSM - Beautiful phone in mint condition. Beautiful phone and looks brand new. Cell Surfers seller is a great seller too. Phone was shipped very fast via FedEx and was beautifully packaged. Highly recommend. Thanks.
Great buy. The Samsung S10e is like new. Thank you for a great deal.

Galaxy S10 works with Tracfone. Bought the Galaxy S10E for my Mom, who has Tracfone. Bought the BYO Phone Sim Kit, registered the SIM on Tracfone website, switched numbers to the new SIM, everything transfered over within 15 minutes. Everything worked well. Will update my review after 30 days to see how phone worked. But this phone will work if you have Tracfone, I can confirm this!
Samsung S10e. I really like the phone, I dislike the assistant manu icon that stays on the screen.

Very Disappointing. This phone could honestly be worse than my Samsung Galaxy S7... Purchased a lot of smart home devices in the past few months. Almost all the apps I used with my S7 for those devices and other are not working at all or as well on this S10e. Wi-fi takes forever to connect - did a side by side comparison while troubleshooting with Samsung. Their plan was to have me bring both phones to their "repair center" so they could narrow down what the issue could be. I'm hoping for updates in the future to make this purchase worth it.

BEWARE OF BUYING FROM SAMSUNG REFURBISHED/RENEWED. I just saw that Samsung has partnered with Amazon to sell renewed/refurbished phones. I would be cautious about buying anything from Samsung renewed/refurbished based on my dealings with them. I bought a Samsung galaxy s10e last year directly from Samsung so that I could get the 1 year warranty instead of buying it through Amazon, 90 day warranty. It cost more, but I thought it was worth it for the 1 year warranty. I had never bought a refurbished phone before so I wanted the reassurance. The s10e is a great phone. Small enough to keep in your pocket, great specs, and a phone jack. It was a great phone until almost a year later I got a “moisture detection” warning in the middle of the night while my phone was charging.
S10E cell phone. I just received this product 2 days ago. Give me 2 more weeks and I'll write a review then.

I wrote this on my S10e. It's a beautiful compact phone 10/10 fully unlocked no carrier bloat or boot screen just the usual Samsung bloat that you can't delete lol grinning squinting face runs nice and smooth too, pretty much brand new but no earbuds which is fine

i was lucky. I was worried from the 1 star reviews but was lucky, my samsung 9s+ had no issues transferring data over to the samsung 10e. I used mint mobile as my network and had no issues with connectivity or service.

Looking great so far.... This is a legit Samsung S10e, it is in excellent condition. This is being written on the first night. I don't have a way to take a picture my other phone is broken but it looks almost brand new. The display side is perfect, I cannot find any blemish's, burn in, nothing. The display is a 10/10. The backside is the only place that I can find any marks. There is a scratch a bit under an inch going across the G where it says "galaxy s10e." That is the only mark I can find. If it wasn't for that and the fingerprints that were on it would look new. I don't care about the scratch so 10/10 on aesthetics and display. Performance is very good so far. It took about an hour to update and set up. I just put in my SIM, and it worked.

Fantastic Phone!. Was looking for a new Samsung phone to replace my Galaxy A01 but everything out there has massive screens with specs that don't match. Additionally, they were all expensive! I came across this Amazon Renewed S10e randomly. Specs were perfect, price was perfect, and it didn't have a ginormous screen! Reqd reviews on the seller and ordered. The phone itself looks brand-new! Very impressed! Packaged very well, too, with peels to remove. The included refurbished USB-C cable and charger are cheap knock-offs so I didn't bother using those. But overall, a phenomenal deal!
Why my phone won't turn on?. No power/won't turn on... I bought samsung S10e as a gift for my mother...
Great option!. Saved me half of what it would have cost through AT&T. Love the smaller size of this Galaxy S10e, pretty color too. Thank you Amazon.

Couldn't be happier with this purchase. The phone I received looks like brand new. Not a scratch, ding, or blemish on it. Beautiful. Installed the SIM card from my old phone and the S10e connected to the mobile network immediately. Set up was simple using the Samsung Smart Switch App. The phone needed several updates which it automatically downloaded for installation. Easy. Painless. I'm always pleasantly surprised when a seller delivers what they advertised. I couldn't be happier with this purchase. Full disclosure, I'm not a hardcore cellphone guy. I use the phone for talking, texting, photos, and occasional video streaming. The S10e fits the bill perfectly.

Glad I picked this one. This phone is amazing, I upgraded from a refurbished Galaxy S5 and what a difference. The phone does not have any damage that I can find and has been working perfectly for the past 2 weeks plus the battery life is fantastic and so long lasting. The fingerprint reader on the side is easy to use even with a case on and the camera is so much better than my previous phone. I was debating between an S10 and this S10e and I am very pleased I chose the S10e.
Great deal on a Samsung S10E. product like new works excellent and an excellent price !

Best Galaxy Variant!. This is truly a reliable version. there is no need for buying the S10 . The S10e is very reliable and the battery is literally all day of use! when the battery is at 10% - I can get 5 hours out of use! I will not be upgrading anytime soon.

Phone is great, disappointed in the charger adapter. The Galaxy S10e works as intended and showed up in really good shape, I couldn't tell that it was refurbished. The charger that was provided with the purchase is made by Samsung but unfortunately does not function properly. After trying several different working cords, it is clear the adapter is nonfunctional.
Fake. hold up this has to be fake one reviewer said that the fingerprint scanner on the screen... this a s10e fingerprint scanner is on the side.

Excellent.. I am so pleased to finally receive the correct phone! I'm a big fan of samsung galaxy S series phones. This is quite a step up from my old one. I set this s10e up easily and quickly. It arrived quickly, packed securely. The charger works perfectly, the phone is fantastic, looks like it's brand new! No issues at all.

Trusted seller. So, let me start with for those that want a quick answer Hybrid IT is definitely a trusted seller as far as my Samsung s10e is concerned. My only regret is that I didn't get the regular s10 or even the s10 plus from them. I wish I could upgrade but this "renewed " s10e is practically brand new. Now I've had this phone for almost a month I wanted top write an honest and informative review because I hesitated and I kept thinking what if I'm making a mistake. Well, Hybrid IT after reading their reviews and looking through multiple sellers I'm glad I took a chance. The battery life is amazing the phone is a major upgrade from my Samsung S6, like I cannot emphasize it enough I am very very careful when it comes to spending more than a few hundred dollars on something.

Perfect.. I paid a few bucks more to purchase from Chubbiestech based on a review and to avoid any problems. (Reading about the A10 reviews was scaring me until I realized I was reading the wrong product lol.) This is for the Samsung Galaxy S10e. Being from the S- product line, it's Samsung's flagship product and you can read the history and differences between the models on Wikipedia. I found this information very helpful. I lucked out with the right Seller and got a phone that really seems brand new and works excellent in every way. (A previous purchase of a different model and seller was excellent in every way but then we discovered it wouldn't charge.) I'm so happy I bought this! Pros Mine was in new condition without a scratch, and functions perfectly in every way.
Love it!. I'm loving this phone. My last one was the S8, so it's a nice upgrade, especially with the camera. Can't go wrong with Samsung s10e.

GREAT PHONE / FAST DELIVERY. Seller shipped fast, got a day early. Samsung Galaxy S10e Phone is completely unlocked, not tied to any service. Was easy to hook it up to Metro PCS, just had to call Metro PCS and give them the IEMI number, connected service to it with no issues. I recommend this seller.

I HIGHLY Recommend RUSS Cellular. RUSS Cellular delivered these Refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10e Cellphones in Just Two (2) Days via FedEx. They arrived in Generic Packaging, but both Cellphones appeared as if Brand New and Work Great. They came with the Charger, USB-C Charging Cable and a USB-C Adapter (which I have Not yet used, nor needed). What this means is that you will never get security/software updates. you cannot remove carrier specific apps, and you don't get features only your carrier offers. Basically, unless you know how to flash the unlocked rom (SM-G970U! XAA variant), you are fkkd. I got very lucky with it being a refurbished, so I'm extremely happy about that. I also got lucky in another way, which is another bias and has potential to be negative for others. The listing says it is a "AT&T/T-Mobile Compatible" phone. Which, for me, meant that I was going to have to buy a new SIM card because I have a Verizon-based SIM. No big deal. When I got it though, the package included a paper that stated this was a Verizon unlocked device and various instructions. So, all I had to due was simply pop my SIM into it and it instantly worked beautifully.
If I can replace this I know I will get a working device.. This product is hands down one of the best phones made. I am just not sure if I got sold one that has issues with connecting to the carrier.

Good value. Mine came from Chubbiestech and was as promised. Unblemished screen and back cover, no issues registering the phone with my tier-2 MVNO carrier. Quality hardware for a reasonable price. (An aside ... dear god Samsung loads a ton of useless spyware/crapware/bloat. Who uses this stuff?).

No issues!. Despite a delay due to USPS shipping from WA to MA during stormy weather, I had no issues once I received the phone. I ordered the S10e 128GB white, unlocked for use with T-Mobile. Took it into T-Mobile to transfer stuff from my old S6 Sprint phone to this new phone and T-Mobile had no issues activating the phone or transfer information. I was worried due to bad reviews about the phones being stolen phones, but I had no issue and am quite happy with the purchase. Came with a USB-C charger (which was needed since all my other cords are the old style) and the key to get to where the SIM card goes.

Item Exactly as Described. I've never purchased a refurbished phone before, and I was a bit worried after reading reviews from people who received phones that were for the wrong network/not unlocked as advertised, but I didn't have that problem at all. In addition, the phone I received is fully functional and cosmetically is in very good shape (almost like new).

This Phone works on Sprint Network they will just transter your number to a GSM chip. I had a CDMA chip in my iPhone I was worried that this phone would not be compatible with the Sprint Network. I chatted with a representative online and they directed me to go into a Sprint store to receive the GSM chip for this phone the process was easy!
This phone was not unlocked!. The seller claims that the phone was unlocked but it definitely was not. It was a Verizon phone and I was unable to use with my cellular carrier.

Phone unlocked by Samsung, not an unlocked phone. They are selling phones that have been unlocked by a code, not that were originally sold unlocked. This means you cannot update the phone unless you use it on a network that it was previously locked to. So, if it was locked to ATT, you cannot update it if you are on Verizon. What this means is that you will never get security/software updates. you cannot remove carrier specific apps, and you don't get features only your carrier offers. Basically, unless you know how to flash the unlocked rom (SM-G970U! XAA variant), you are fkkd. You can find instructions on XDA on how to do this, but it is not a straightforward procedure and certainly not for notices. My phone came with Android 9 and the June security patch, so the software was almost a year old. I'm now on Android 10 with the February patch.
Not unlocked phones at all.. This phone says fully unlocked on the box but starts up and says its T-mobile. Well I got scammed. Don't trust these folks.

This phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network. I was so happy with the phone. It arrived quicker than promised. It was in excellent condition. It was packaged professionally. THEN... After 4 lengthy calls with AT&T, I called the Seller, GizmoTrader. The Customer Service Rep was extremely nice but he confirmed this phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network in February after they delete the 3G service. The Samsung S10e Model # G970F is not included on AT&T's list of phones that will work. There are other S10e Model #'s that will work but this one will not.

Stolen phones, no carrier will connect. Got the phone, and everything was fine. But when I went to connect it with verizon, the customer service representative informed that the phone was black listed! This is a result of this phone being stolen property. SMH no one will connect a stolen phone, who ever sells these is a true piece of work

Beautiful like new device, terrible customer service. Just to start this review off, wanted to say I got my device from the seller Chubbiestech (when you look at the reviews for this product it doesn't say what seller they recieved their phone from). My phone is perfect. It looks and works just like a new one. It came packaged well with a new third party charger and adapter. I love it with all my heart :^) Don't be scared by some of the reviews. I don't know if I just got lucky but I have Verizon and changed my service to this phone with absolutely no problems. On the customer service tip, I did have a hard time getting the sd card slot out (which I guess is harder than my previous phone because of the build). I thought it was stuck so I called the number listed on the little pamphlet that came with my order.

This is not a scam!. Like many other consumers, I was very very worried that my phone would be a stolen phone or that it would not come carrier unlocked. The seller was Chubbiestech and my phone came factory unlocked to my relief. I do think it's important to check who the seller is specifically. All that aside, the phone works great! I love the smaller size of the Galaxy s10e compared the the s10 or s10+. All the cameras take fantastic pictures. As always, Samsung killed it.
